name: Stopwatch and timer
title: Online Stopwatch with Laps and Countdown Timer
description: A free online stopwatch with lap times and a countdown timer with an alarm. Keyboard shortcuts, full-screen digits, and it keeps running if you refresh.
summary: A stopwatch with laps and a countdown timer with an alarm.
howTo: Stopwatch: press Start, then Lap to record splits. Stop and resume as often as you like; Reset clears it.
Timer: switch to Timer, type hours, minutes and seconds or tap a quick time like 5 or 25 minutes, and press Start.
When the timer ends it beeps, and the tab title says “Time’s up”. Use +1 min to add time, even after it has finished.
Keyboard: <kbd>Space</kbd> starts and stops, <kbd>L</kbd> records a lap and <kbd>R</kbd> resets.

faq.q: Does it keep running if I switch tabs or refresh?
faq.a: Yes. Both work from the clock time they started at, not from a counter in the page, so switching tabs, locking your phone or refreshing doesn’t lose time. The countdown also shows in the tab title.

faq.q: Why didn’t the timer make a sound?
faq.a: Browsers only allow sound after you’ve clicked something on the page, so start the timer with a click or tap. Check that Play a sound is ticked and your device isn’t muted. If the timer finished while the page was closed, it shows “Time’s up” without a sound.
It shows hundredths of a second and is accurate to a few milliseconds, which is far finer than the time it takes to press a button.

faq.q: Can I copy my lap times?
faq.a: Yes. Copy laps copies every lap as a table that pastes straight into Excel or Google Sheets.
